LESSON: MY CLASSMATES

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: My Neighbourhood
Topic 4.1: My classmates
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers My classmates, part of My Neighbourhood in SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: Why do we have neighbours?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on My classmates together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Citizenship: learner develops relationships when playing games harmoniously with classmates.

Communication and collaboration: learner plays and prays with classmates.

Values:
Love: learner portrays a caring attitude when sharing play materials with classmates.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Social cohesion: learner enhances kindness and friendliness when playing games with classmates.

Link to other learning area:

Friends as our neighbours relates to the concept of loving our neighbours in Religious Activities

Suggested Learning Resources

Charts, picture cards, drawn pictures, glue, crayons, realia, photos, coloured pencils, school environment, learners, digital devices with assistive
